name: Rari Capital
rootCause: Rari Capital was exploited via malicious upgrades to its lending pool's comptroller contracts on Ethereum, enabling attackers to borrow without collateral and drain over $2 million. Evidence confirms key compromise and insider manipulation, not a simple uninitialized proxy error. A compromised multisig allowed malicious upgrades to the comptroller, introducing backdoor logic that exempted attacker addresses from collateral checks. This insider/key-compromise bypassed access control on upgradeable proxies.
